tool_description: Performs an NCBI Entrez ESearch to retrieve a list of UIDs matching the given query term in the specified database. Handles URL-encoding, rate-limiting (1 s delay), and returns parsed JSON.

term.description: Search term, which will be URL-encoded.

retmax.description: Maximum number of UIDs to return.

esearchresult.description: Search results: total count, returned count, start index, and list of UIDs.
